activities.description: Speaker delivers a monologue about the role of communicators.

scenes.contextualRelevance: By drawing parallels between different levels of leadership, the speaker implies that effective communication is crucial at all levels of society.

narrativeProgression.description: The speaker states that leaders like mayors, premiers, and presidents are the 'face' of their respective entities.
He emphasizes the importance of communicators in conveying messages on behalf of leaders.
He explains the role of communicators in ensuring the smooth and consistent flow of information from leadership to the public.

youtube_description:
Brian Zuma discusses the function of his office as a spokesperson at the Msunduzi Municipality. He leaves his post as the Head of Communications at the end of February 2014, a position he has held for 9 years.
